learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn to use replacing words: He for boys/men, She for girls/women, and It for animals/things.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Rahul is a good boy. Rahul plays cricket. Rahul loves ice cream. Ah, saying 'Rahul' again and again is tiring! Let's learn magic words that take the place of names.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Sometimes, we don't want to repeat the same Naming Word again and again. So, we use special Replacing Words like He, She, or It. They make our sentences sound much better!
examples_or_templates: Ria is happy. -> She is happy.
The ball is red. -> It is red.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'He' when we are talking about one boy or a man.
examples_or_templates: This is Papa. He is tall. 👨
This is Rohan. He is playing. 👦

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'She' when we are talking about one girl or a woman.
examples_or_templates: This is Mummy. She is sweet. 👩
This is Riya. She is dancing. 👧

lesson_modules.module_title: 🧸 Using 'It' (यह/वह - जानवरों और वस्तुओं के लिए)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'It' when we talk about one animal, bird, place, or thing.
examples_or_templates: I have a dog. It is cute. 🐕
Look at the car. It is fast. 🚗

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which word will you use for your Father?
❓ '___ is a beautiful dress.' What comes in the blank?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Replace the name with He, She, or It: 'Rahul is my friend.' -> '____ is my friend.'
✍️ Fill in the blank: The cat is hungry. ____ wants milk.
subjective_practice.hint: Use the word we use for animals.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Look at a picture of your mother. Would you use He, She, or It for her?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 He, She, It Sorting Bowl
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Take three bowls and label them He, She, and It. Write words like Uncle, Aunt, Tiger, Bat, Boy, Girl on small chits and put them in the correct bowls!

chapter_summary: ⭐ We use 'He' for a boy or man.
⭐ We use 'She' for a girl or woman.
⭐ We use 'It' for an animal, place, or thing.
